intent: generate new modular layout concepts using actual current Studio screenshots as identity references

images.reference_role: Current live game visual identity and cheap material/furniture baseline; not an exact layout reproduction
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: improved playable Roblox/Blender Level 3 environment concept, 1536x1024 landscape single scene.
Input image 1 is an ACTUAL CURRENT GAME SCREENSHOT, a visual identity reference only: preserve the cheap lifeless children's party venue, low ceiling, furniture types, beige walls and ugly green-brown carpet. Invent a better modular room arrangement, do not reproduce the exact camera composition or any HUD.
Primary request: improve this specific budget late-1990s mall children's birthday backrooms environment while KEEPING its semi-dirty middle/lower-income-family pricepoint. It is empty after closing, still maintained but tired, with awkward cheap optimism. A worn BEIGE PARTY HALL. Very low square-grid drop ceiling with yellowed beige tiles and thin black grids, ordinary flat rectangular fluorescent lamps; faded slightly stained cream-yellow walls and black vinyl skirting. Ugly low-pile green/brown/red mottled geometric carpet like the reference, showing foot traffic and small local stains.
A wide clear central walking route passes three cheap rectangular laminate folding tables arranged as loose clusters, black folding metal legs, scuffed mismatched red green yellow blue stackable molded plastic chairs. Offset boxy wall on left gives a readable side branch; another broad untrimmed rectangular opening at rear reveals a further fluorescent room, creating enticing depth. A modest patched laminate cake-serving counter along one wall, a small recessed niche with spare chairs stacked, one small bunch of balloons and a crooked paper birthday garland. Paper cups and a few leftover paper plates, sparse enough to feel empty. This is ordinary practical rented party space, not lavish entertainment design.
Style: carefully composed moderately stylized 3D indie horror game environment / polished Blender concept, restrained bevels, economical reusable models. Improve through clear shapes, natural material detail, depth and gentle lighting, not luxury. Eye-level 28mm wide view, room comfortably visible, low claustrophobic ceiling occupying upper quarter; central path unobstructed. Warm dirty-white fluorescent light with mild contrast, readable darker corridors, no heavy darkness or orange bloom.
Constraints: one dry flat floor, no people, no monsters, no water or pools, no gore, no heavy ruin, no plants. No luxury hotel, marble, terrazzo, velvet, banquettes, chandelier, cove lighting, high ceiling, vaults, arches, glass shopfronts, neon spectacle, atrium, palace, modern designer furniture. No captions, logos, watermarks or HUD. Render one coherent image, not collage.
images.visual_assessment: Preserves low gridded beige ceiling, fluorescent panels, tired beige walls, green/brown carpet and cheap multicolour plastic chairs. Adds convincing central path, branching rectangular passages, basic serving counter and stacked-chair niche. Faithful affordable party-room identity without luxury drift; render is more realistic/detailed than current Roblox appearance.

images.prompt:

Middle/lower-income-family pricepoint, semi-dirty with scuffed chairs, faded wall paint, tired carpet, slightly yellowed ceiling and small taped repairs, still maintained rather than abandoned ruin. Empty, mundane, awkwardly festive.
Make two offset party alcoves connected by a clearly readable generous main walking path. Separate them with plain boxy wall piers, wide rectangular openings glimpsing the next room. Maintain an intimate low claustrophobic beige grid ceiling with basic flat rectangular fluorescent fixtures, faded orange wall paint and a broad matte black lower wall band. Dark cheap low-pile carpet with small red yellow blue green confetti flecks, visibly worn in walking areas.
Three cheap rectangular pale laminate folding tables with black metal folding legs, small mismatched red/green/blue/yellow molded plastic stackable chairs, no luxurious furniture. One long narrow cake-serving table against a wall with sparse paper plates and colored cups, a mostly empty plate, very modest paper birthday decorations. Small balloon bunch, a couple of partly deflated balloons. One cheap black wall-mounted PA speaker. At far side a half-open ordinary beige staff door shows a tiny sliver of cool fluorescent backroom light and simple utility shelves, another branch visible to the left.
Style: refined but moderately stylized 3D indie horror game environment / realistic-material Blender concept, restrained bevels and practical reusable modular kit. Improve through layout, material separation and subtle lighting, keep the same plain affordable party-room identity.

images.visual_assessment: Preserves orange upper walls, black lower band, low tired tiled ceiling, confetti carpet and basic laminate folding tables/plastic chairs. Adds clear offset second party area, ordinary staff-room doorway, cake table and PA speaker. Carpet has fairly pronounced central wear but scene remains maintained rather than ruined. Moderate darkness, readable details. No luxury drift; not a Blender model or performance proof.
